collections.name: THE CHRISTMAS YARD
collections.description:
Dear Diary, still early days of December... sitting at my window, I think of the morning as being incredibly dreamy. My nose pushing up against the cold glass, I take in the colorful homes braving the snow, putting on their brightest faces... Pine trees blanketed in white, their fresh fragrance disappearing into front doors.

 A Blue Car full of brightly wrapped gifts turning a corner, a curious Reindeer dragging down the bright baubles... what an unusual visitor! I could almost imagine Elves outside my window! Or were those gnomes? It all felt wonderfully warm and joyously disarming. 

Now I would be grossly remiss if I forget to mention that these are some of the charming views we selected for our recently launched Holiday Collection - The Christmas Yard. 

You can pick any design of Table Mat and pair it with any of the Table Runners - or you could pick every single design and make a unique set for yourself. You'll be spoiled for choice! 

Bespoke pieces In Cream and Light Blue to plan your lunches and dinners with family and friends. Carefully placing every piece of linen, crockery, and craft... Oh the absolute thrill of hosting!!

collections.name: EQUESTRIAN
collections.description:
Like a leaf riding the wind, the sound of his shoes announcing our arrival...

"Start of a fine day", I say. "Nobility is here", he neighs.

I patted Mirza before dismounting. Years of bonding, he understood the unspoken.

"You are a remarkable companion", I said. "You're not too bad yourself, he snorted, some day you may even be remarkable!"

The exchange of emotions between the horse and his rider became our inspiration for this range. Soft colours hand-embroidered with Metallics are used in this collection to highlight human ties with nature. The Equestrian range holds pride of place in our collections for being simple yet strong.

collections.name: LIFE AT COURT
collections.description:
Royal households along with their retinue have always drawn curiosities. What were they like, how did they live and how did they entertain... It's the stuff of fairy tales.

Rare glimpses of that timeless opulence left us all thirsting for its grandeur. Here at Pomegranate 'n' Lime we sought to bring forth that stateliness, which lingers deep within our soul, glimpses that are all too familiar and an Era that is bygone for most because, 'most' were never part of it. For a select few these are not memories... These caresses of opulence are Home, now and always.

The motifs picked for this collection are moments picked from a Grand Lifestyle. The moments have passed but the grandeur endures within us. Let that yearning come to life as you select these pieces that tie your present and inherited elegance - welcome to your homecoming.

Complete sets are available in Black, White and Gray - embroidered in colours and motifs that mirror the resplendence of Life At Court.

collections.name: SAILS UP
collections.description:
The scents and smell of the sea... Sailing is such a delight to the senses, the world disappears into the distance and the only thing on our mind is that dialogue we are having at Sea, with the Sea. How many knots? Are the waters choppy? A lot of white horses today... Hoist the sails and unfurl the gib...

The beautiful boats and their vibrant sails - in our nautical collection, we borrowed a few beautiful visuals from the Ocean, and I daresay, the colors she offered up! How Deep does she go? My thoughts exactly... 

The Pomegranate 'n' Lime collection of Sails Up is full of surprises, just like the Ocean it was inspired by. Shells, sand, lighthouses and sails in a myriad of colours - it's all there.

collections.name: KESARIYA
collections.description:
The Kesariya collection is inspired by a land ensconced in bravery, bound by duty and guided by a sense of sacrifice - the land of the Warrior Kings.

The land of rising sand dunes and falling enemies. For their people were aristocratic in style, honourable in word and magnificent with their swords! We bring a brief glimpse of their stories to you. Stories that hold influence even now - the influence of a glorious living tradition that some like to call history. 

Rajputana is a profusion of culture which has allured many for centuries. The motifs and colours of this collection pay homage to the symbols of honour and heritage. The sword and the turban ornament - accompaniments in war and celebration. The people of this land still savour life as a feast, both in the barren deserts as well as the bustling ramparts of cities.

Pick a piece of this living history to revel in the joy of colours and contrasts - pick Kesariya and live the legends of Rajputana.

products.description:
Bespoke  hand-embroidered Mats, Runners and Napkins. This range is a tribute to the Brave Hearts of Rajputana and a life lived by them strictly dictated by a code of  honor. A few symbols that became synonymous with their existence  have been taken as motifs for this range. The first is the sword and the second is the Kalgi (a piece of jewellery ) they wore on their Safa (Turban). Each Mat, Runner or Napkin depicts a different part of the same symbol.

There are Two Base Colors available under this theme, Cream and Black and both follow a different style with their own unique color combinations.

The Black series is unique in the use of colours - each mat has the same motif in different colour combinations. So each mat is a part of the set adhering to the same palette, yet different in its combination.

items.question: How can I track my order?
items.answer: Once your order has been shipped, we will send the tracking details to your registered email address and mobile number. You can also view your order status under 'My Orders' in your account.

items.question: Can I change or cancel an order after placing it?
items.answer: Orders cannot be cancelled or amended once they have been confirmed. Please check the items, quantity, delivery address, and contact information carefully before completing your purchase.

items.question: Can I change the quantity or product in my confirmed order?
items.answer: Confirmed orders cannot be modified. If you would like another item or a different quantity, please place a new order.

items.question: Can I return or exchange a product?
items.answer: No return or exchange is available for any of our products.

items.question: Are discounted products or products on sale eligible for return or exchange?
items.answer: No. Products purchased during a sale or on discount are not eligible for return or exchange. Also, Products purchased before a sale cannot be exchanged during the sale period.

items.question: What should I do if I receive a damaged package?
items.answer:
You are advised to take a picture or preferably record a video of the package and send it to our support team within 24 hours of receiving the package. Please check if the items inside the package are damaged. Record a video of the unboxing and send it to our support team. Our team will review the information and guide you through to the next steps.
Please make sure you intimate support@pomegranatenlime.com within 24 hours of receiving the package. Any damage claims made after 24 hours of receiving the package will not be entertained.

items.question: How long is a credit note valid?
items.answer: Credit notes are valid for 3 months from the date of issue and may be redeemed online.

items.question: Are your products handmade?
items.answer: Most of the Pomegranate ’n’ Lime pieces are handmade and crafted with close attention to detail. Subtle differences in colour, finish, or appearance of the fabric and thread may naturally occur and contribute to the individuality of each piece. Please refer to the individual product page for specific details.

items.question: Where can I find product dimensions and care instructions?
items.answer: Product-specific information is available on each product page under Description, About, Care Instructions, and Disclaimer. Please review these details before placing your order.

items.question: Are product colours exactly as shown online?
items.answer: We aim to display product colours and finishes as accurately as possible. However, appearance may vary slightly because of screen settings, lighting, photography, and the individual character of handcrafted products.

items.question: Do I need an account to shop?
items.answer: You may browse products without an account. However, creating an account makes it easier to view orders, track shipments, and maintain your wish list.

items.question: How does the Wish-listt work?
items.answer: Select the Heart or Wish-list button on a product to save it for later. You may be asked to sign in so that your saved products remain linked to your account.

items.question: How can I contact Pomegranate ’n’ Lime?

The 'Contact Us' form is also available on our Contact Page. You can fill that out with your name, order number, registered email address, and a short description of your query.

items.question: How soon will my order be dispatched?
items.answer: Orders are generally prepared, inspected, and dispatched within 4-6 business days after confirmation. If you have not received a dispatch update within five business days, please contact our support team on support@pomegranatenlime.com

items.question: How long does delivery take?
items.answer:
Standard delivery usually takes 10–15 business days after dispatch. Metro locations may receive orders within 6-7 business days, while regional or remote locations may take 15–25 business days.
Delivery timeline is estimated from the time you place your order and may be affected by your location, courier availability, holidays, or other circumstances outside our control.

items.question: Can I change my delivery address after placing an order?
items.answer: Please review your address carefully before confirming your order. Once an order is confirmed, it cannot be amended. Orders sent to an incorrect or incomplete address are not eligible for exchange or a refund.

items.question: What happens if delivery is unsuccessful?
items.answer: In case you are unavailable to receive the delivery, our delivery partner will attempt to contact you through your registered mobile number. This attempt will be made twice after which the delivery will be returned to sender.

items.question: Do you ship Internationally?
items.answer: Yes we do ship Internationally. However, you must register your complete address to check if delivery is available in your area. All applicable shipping charges will be shown during checkout. Import duties, taxes, and customs charges imposed by the destination country must be paid by the recipient. An international order is not eligible for a refund if the recipient refuses to pay these charges or refuses to collect the shipment.
